messages:
Sam K: after our CI bumped @redwood/client to 0.21.0, production started returning 404s for sessions.create. deploy was ~0900 UTC and errors spiked immediately
Priya N: which version did you upgrade from? any lockfile changes?
Sam K: was on 0.19.0 -> 0.21.0. yarn.lock changed during the deploy. repro steps below
Sam K: repro steps:
1) yarn add @redwood/client@0.21.0
2) ts code:
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/client';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.sessions.create({ user_id: 'acct_789' });
```
3) observed: 404 response with body { message: "route not found" }
Sam K: network inspector shows POST /v1/session/create -> 404 (note singular 'session')
Mikhail V: that path looks like the SDK emitted singular path while server expects plural /v1/sessions. we changed a few helpers in 0.20 but did not rename public surface intentionally
Priya N: can you paste package.json snippet + node version?
Sam K: node 18.16.0, typescript 5.1, package.json snippet:
```json
"dependencies": {
  "@redwood/client": "^0.21.0",
  "node-fetch": "^3.3.0"
}
```
Eng SDK: quick check — v0.21.0 introduced a thin facade that maps method names to endpoints; there was a refactor that accidentally emitted the singular route for session-related methods. server-side routing rollout didn't include an alias, so 404s for customers using that SDK until we push a patch
Sam K: rolling back to 0.19.0 in prod immediately removed the 404s
Sam K: temporary workaround for affected services: call the plural endpoint directly via fetch:
```js
await fetch(process.env.RW_URL + '/v1/sessions', {
  method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + process.env.RW_KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 'acct_789' })
});
```
Support Bot: Ticket #SUP-2067-992 opened and linked to incident INC-2026-77
Priya N: thanks — please pin affected customers to 0.19.x in the status update and communicate the rollback workaround
Eng SDK: created PR to add a compatibility shim in 0.21.x that maps /v1/session/create -> /v1/sessions and added unit + e2e tests. also will publish 0.21.1 patch today
Mikhail V: ops will add a server alias route for the next deploy to tolerate both paths for a week
Sam K: noted for the incident timeline. customers reported break during business hours. will update external postmortem after fixes land :thumbsup:
